packageRules.description: The oracle. A socket.io version change is a conformance signal to read, not a chore, so each lands as its own PR and never auto-merges.
All build and test tooling in one weekly PR, with the patch stream separated so patches can be told apart from minors.
Patch updates of stable 1.0 and up tooling auto-merge once CI is green. Pre-1.0 tooling stays on manual review, since 0.x can break in a patch.
